title: Hazel Rose finds strength in the struggle with a soulful song of hope “Meet You There”
htmlContent: Hazel Rose's latest single, "Meet You There," explores struggle, healing, and hope for brighter days ahead. "Meet You There" reflects on her experiences and a conversation with a more optimistic future self. Hazel Rose shares her feelings with incredible honesty, blending heartfelt lyrics with sounds from live drums, bass, and warm trumpets. The outcome is a personal song celebrating resilience with its natural melodies. "Meet You There" brings back a sense of childhood wonder. The harmonies prompt feelings of innocence and memories, reminding us of the dreams we once held dear. Instead of getting lost in memories, the song gently pushes us forward, promoting growth, healing, and the belief in what lies ahead. https://open.spotify.com/track/2geBLh8qsLztIgKGIDwM1x?si=vJEleUlBTzGvFJoCtG4UYg Hazel Rose's storytelling resonates universally, reminding us that we've all experienced moments of uncertainty when the future seems distant. "Meet You There" offers a comforting reminder that hope is always nearby, even in our toughest times. Sometimes, the person we want to become is already out there waiting for us, we need to embark on the journey to meet them. Hazel Rose shares her personal story and extends a hand to those who may need some encouragement in their own lives. Follow on: Instagram/TikTok
